walk:
Create a production game sprite atlas with a genuinely transparent background. Exactly 6 equal columns and 4 equal rows, all cells equal size, no gutters, NO TEXT, NO LABELS, NO grid lines. Aspect ratio 3:2, ideally 1536 by 1024. Each cell contains a SINGLE full-body version of the SAME beautiful adult Czech woman Hana, aged about 30, classically beautiful balanced face, clear expressive eyes, golden blonde hair fully visible with a substantial long braid, small muted terracotta scarf tied BELOW and behind her hairline. Cream embroidered blouse with loose sleeves, fitted blue-teal ankle-length skirt, cream apron with subtle red/blue folk embroidery, dark brown ankle boots, wicker gathering basket at her right hip. Painterly premium storybook game art with detailed gouache textures, natural adult proportions, fine face, warm soft daylight from upper left. NOT vector clip art, NOT chibi, NOT pixel art, NOT 3D rendering.
Atlas layout: row 1 six consecutive walking frames facing front-right three-quarter, row 2 same six-step walk facing front-left three-quarter, row 3 six walking frames viewed from back-right three-quarter, row 4 six walking frames viewed from back-left three-quarter. Keep basket on anatomical right in all views. WALK cycle: contact, down, passing, opposite contact, down, passing, with real leg and arm changes. All heads same size, all feet at the same baseline within each cell. Figure occupies central 68% of cell width and 88% cell height, empty transparent margin around every figure. No crops, no cast shadow, no ground, no background objects. Maintain her identity, anatomy, scale, clothing, blonde braid, and rendering style perfectly across all 24 cells.
actions:
Use the reference ONLY for Hana's identity, clothing, golden blonde braid, and painterly storybook style. Create a NEW animation atlas with exactly 4 equal columns and 3 equal rows on genuinely transparent alpha, NO TEXT, NO grid, NO shadows, NO glow, NO background. Each cell a centered FULL BODY figure, consistent scale and baseline, 12 distinct poses with space separating all cells.
Row1 Hana in cream embroidered blouse, blue-teal ankle-length skirt, embroidered cream apron, brown boots, and wicker basket: cell1 relaxed standing front-right 3/4, cell2 reaching down to gather a potato, cell3 lifting one potato in hand, cell4 placing potato in basket.
Row2 same Hana: cell1 singing with one hand near heart and other extended, lips slightly parted; cell2 preparing potatoes at waist height, no furniture; cell3 stirring with wooden spoon, no pot/furniture; cell4 holding a small serving dish with cooked potatoes.
Row3 cell1 same blonde Hana as a radiant harvest goddess, full body, elegant cream embroidered dress and floral wheat crown, face and golden blonde braid unchanged, no glow drawn; cells2,3,4 JOHN a classically handsome CLEAN SHAVEN adult man about35, sandy BLONDE swept hair, strong defined jaw, balanced face, handsome natural adult proportions, sage rolled-sleeve shirt, brown fitted waistcoat, olive trousers, dark boots: cell2 standing relaxed front-left3/4; cell3 greeting with raised hand warm smile; cell4 sitting at dinner on a simple wooden chair holding a spoon (no table).
All faces beautiful/ handsome realistic storybook adults, cohesive detailed gouache painting, not caricature or vector. Same upper-left daylight throughout, transparent alpha everywhere between figures, never any colored sheet or gradient. EXACT 4 columns x3 rows.
portraits: Create a premium painted storybook game portrait sheet with EXACTLY two equal square panels side by side, same size. Wide 2:1 image. Left panel HANA, right panel JOHN. Use attached atlas as precise identity/clothing reference. Both attractive adults, detailed gouache illustration not cartoon vector, cohesive gentle golden daylight. HANA is around30 with classically beautiful balanced features, clear blue-green eyes, golden BLONDE thick braid over shoulder, visible blonde crown hair, small terracotta scarf tied behind below hairline, embroidered cream Czech rural blouse, teal bodice belt. JOHN around35, classically handsome clean-shaven adult man, sandy BLONDE swept hair, defined jaw, green-blue eyes, sage shirt and warm brown waistcoat. Warm attentive expressions, shoulders and upper chest, faces centered and LARGE. Cream parchment background in both panels, no border, no text, no props, no watermark. Maintain likeness to atlas but polish portrait detail, adult facial anatomy.
percy: Production game sprite atlas of PERCY, one adult seal point tabby cat. Exactly 3 equal columns by 2 equal rows on genuinely transparent background. Each cell contains the same full-body cat at consistent scale, centered with generous transparent margins. Cream body, dark seal-brown ears muzzle paws and tail, clear tabby stripes on the face and points, blue eyes, short soft fur, healthy natural cat anatomy. Premium detailed painterly gouache storybook art, gentle warm upper-left light, no outlines, NOT clipart, NOT chibi, not photographic. Row1: sitting alert three-quarter left; same sitting pose with eyes gently closed blinking; same sitting with head turned toward viewer and tail tip lifted. Row2: curled asleep; stretching forelegs down with back gently arched; standing contented with tail up in three-quarter left view. No collar, no people, no text, no grid, no furniture, no floor, no cast shadows, no colored background or gradient. Cat's full ears and tail and paws inside each equal cell. Maintain same individual cat across six cells.
